# FDG9014

> DO NOT design factored types that have modes.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: whether a type has modes is a design judgment; section 9.1.2 and the body give the Stream example.

## From the book

Factored types should have a well-defined life span scoped to a single mode. For example, instances of `Stream` can either read or write, and an instantiated stream is already opened.
